events.title: Henry V of England dies at Vincennes
events.description: Henry V, victor of Agincourt and heir to the French throne, died of dysentery aged 35. His nine-month-old son Henry VI inherited a dual monarchy that soon unravelled.
events.html: Henry V, victor of Agincourt and heir to the French throne, died of dysentery aged 35. His nine-month-old son Henry VI inherited a dual monarchy that soon unravelled.

events.title: An earthquake devastates Charleston, South Carolina
events.description: A powerful earthquake struck Charleston, damaging most of its buildings and killing about 60 people. It remains the strongest recorded earthquake in the south-eastern United States.
events.html: A powerful earthquake struck Charleston, damaging most of its buildings and killing about 60 people. It remains the strongest recorded earthquake in the south-eastern United States.

events.title: Mary Ann Nichols is murdered in Whitechapel
events.description: The body of Mary Ann Nichols was found in Buck's Row, the first of five victims generally attributed to 'Jack the Ripper'. The killer was never identified.
events.html: The body of Mary Ann Nichols was found in Buck's Row, the first of five victims generally attributed to 'Jack the Ripper'. The killer was never identified.

events.title: SS men stage a fake Polish attack at Gleiwitz
events.description: SS operatives seized the German radio station at Gleiwitz and broadcast an anti-German message, posing as Polish raiders. Hitler used such incidents to justify invading Poland the next morning.
events.html: SS operatives seized the German radio station at Gleiwitz and broadcast an anti-German message, posing as Polish raiders. Hitler used such incidents to justify invading Poland the next morning.

events.title: Trinidad and Tobago becomes independent
events.description: Trinidad and Tobago gained independence from Britain, with Eric Williams as prime minister. Oil and gas wealth made it one of the most prosperous nations in the Caribbean.
events.html: Trinidad and Tobago gained independence from Britain, with Eric Williams as prime minister. Oil and gas wealth made it one of the most prosperous nations in the Caribbean.

events.title: Diana, Princess of Wales dies in a Paris car crash
events.description: Diana was fatally injured when her car crashed in the Pont de l'Alma tunnel while pursued by photographers. Her death provoked an extraordinary outpouring of public grief in Britain and beyond.
